scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build:app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build:app: cd app && npm install --include=dev && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist
